question.text: In a carnot engine, the temperature of reservoir is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>527</mn><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> and that of sink is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>200</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math>. If the workdone by the engine when it transfers heat from reservoir to sink is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>12000</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kJ</mi></math>, the quantity of heat absorbed by the engine from reservoir is _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>6</mn></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">J</mi></math>.

solution.text:
Efficiency of Carnot engine is η=1-TLTH=WQ, where, Q is heat absorbed.

Here, TH=527+273=800 K

Now, η=1-200800=12Q

∴ 34=12000Q

∴ Q=16×106 J
